row.title: CODE-REGULATOR-1 sampled audit and D1 schema export
row.body: Adds P8 audit sampling (protected paths always, others by a deterministic rate that doubles on a defect and halves on a clean audit) and the ledger SQL for a D1 mirror. Ran 20 regulator tests, they pass. Nothing calls the sampler yet, so the hypothesis that sampled audit lowers reviewer cost is untested.
